title: Gray-Code Increment
constraints: `g` is an 8-bit reflected Gray code. Output `gn` = the Gray code of the **next** value (wrapping 255 → 0).
No loops or generate: convert with shift-XOR steps.
hints: Gray → binary is a prefix XOR: `b = g ^ (g >> 1) ^ (g >> 2) ^ … ^ (g >> 7)`, or in 3 doubling steps.
Increment the binary value, then binary → Gray: `n ^ (n >> 1)`.
Pure-Gray trick without conversion: if the parity of g is even, flip bit 0, otherwise flip the bit left of the lowest 1.
